name: FAKE ン RARE
description: A Fake Rare that repaints itself. The banner turns every six hours through the 500 highest-valued Fake Rares and comes home to the artist's own line every 125.25 days; the seal carries the Bitcoin block each name was issued in; the sweatshirt turns over every day between his F and his C. Nothing is generated - every mark is his paint, re-struck by a dry-brush engine from a single self-verifying JSON.
